content.title: Bain Capital-backed Heartflow eyes $1.32 billion valuation as medtech IPOs rebound
content.summary: (Reuters) -Medical technology company Heartflow said on Friday it was targeting a valuation of up to $1.32 billion in its U.S. initial public offering, more than three years after its previous attempt to go public fell through.  Mountain View, California-based Heartflow is seeking up to $212.5 million by offering 12.5 million shares priced between $15 and $17 apiece.  Heartflow's listing also comes amid a nascent rebound in medical technology IPOs after a years-long downturn.
